result.response:
The issue reported in LANG-720 and specified in `summary.txt` has been resolved.

### Root Cause
In [`CharSequenceTranslator.translate(CharSequence, Writer)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/translate/CharSequenceTranslator.java#L75-L105), the loop bound `len` was calculated using `Character.codePointCount(input, 0, input.length())` instead of the character sequence length `input.length()`. However, `pos` tracked char indices into `input`. Furthermore, when `consumed == 0`, `pos` was incremented by only 1 rather than by the number of code units `c.length` (`Character.charCount(codePoint)`), resulting in surrogate characters being split/mishandled and characters following supplementary characters being skipped or truncated before the loop terminated early.

### Changes Made
1. In [`CharSequenceTranslator.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_b_fix/src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/translate/CharSequenceTranslator.java#L80-L100):
   - Set `len = input.length()`.
   - When no translator consumes the character (`consumed == 0`), advanced `pos += c.length;` and continued to the next iteration.
   - For consumed code points (`consumed > 0`), properly incremented `pos += Character.charCount(Character.codePointAt(input, pos))`.
2. Generated the patch file [`nl_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/lang_17_group_b_fix/nl_fix.patch) containing only source code modifications.

### Verification
The original failing test `org.apache.commons.lang3.StringEscapeUtilsTest::testLang720` passes successfully.
